# "Armed for Battle"
## Scripture
"Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil." – Ephesians 6:11

## Reflection
As warriors of Christ, we are called to be armed for battle. Not just any battle, but the spiritual war that rages within and around us. This battle is not just about our individual struggles, but also about the spiritual state of our families, communities, and world. To be effective in this battle, we must don the whole armor of God. This includes the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shoes of the gospel of peace, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit. We must be intentional about putting on this armor each day, so that we may stand strong against the schemes of the enemy. This is not just a one-time act, but a daily discipline that requires commitment, focus, and faith.

## Daily Challenge
"Walk through your day with purpose, knowing that you are armed and ready to face whatever comes your way." Do 25 squats while declaring your dependence on God's strength.
